# langsmith_dataset_split (Resource)

Declares the membership of a named split within a dataset. The LangSmith API does not expose per-example split membership, so this resource can verify the split *name* exists but cannot detect drift in `example_ids`. Updates compute add/remove diffs against state; destroy removes every example currently in state from the split (which deletes the split server-side when empty).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_dataset_split" "train" {
  dataset_id = langsmith_dataset.golden.id
  name       = "train"
  example_ids = [
    langsmith_example.first.id,
    langsmith_example.second.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset_id` (String) UUID of the parent dataset.
- `example_ids` (Set of String) Set of example UUIDs that belong to this split.
- `name` (String) Split name (e.g. `train`, `test`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
